author: xkcd's What If?
description:
We’ve just refreshed the xkcd store! https://store.xkcd.com/

Get a copy of What If? 2 and Randall’s other books at: https://xkcd.com/books
More serious answers to absurd questions at: https://what-if.xkcd.com/

This question comes from James, who asks: what percentage of the Sun's heat (per day) does the population of Earth eat in calories per year? What changes could be made to our diets for the amount of calories to equal the energy of the Sun?

Each year, humans eat about 0.000000000065% of the sun’s daily energy output. We’re going to need some help.
